taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-09, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To find the curve-type notation, we first list the resistivities of the layers in order:
$\rho_1 = 975.4 \ \Omega\text{m}$
$\rho_2 = 552.4 \ \Omega\text{m}$
$\rho_3 = 730.5 \ \Omega\text{m}$
$\rho_4 = 1710.8 \ \Omega\text{m}$

Next, we analyze each group of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** 
    Compare $\rho_1, \rho_2, \rho_3$:
    $975.4 > 552.4$ and $552.4 < 730.5$
    The pattern is $\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$, which corresponds to the letter **H**.

2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** 
    Compare $\rho_2, \rho_3, \rho_4$:
    $552.4 < 730.5$ and $730.5 < 1710.8$
    The pattern is $\rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.

Combining the letters in order, the curve type is **HA**.

{"curve_type": "HA"}
